description: Lists devices owned by the configured provider account. v0.3 supports AirThings (requires AIRTHINGS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET). For AirGradient owned sensors use air_search_public_sensors instead.

privacy_mode.description: Optional privacy mode: summary | structured | raw. summary omits location identifiers and device serials when present; structured/raw return full payload.

name: air_list_devices
title: Air list devices
